title: 第9章 这不可能一定是我大意了第10章 能修吐纳功宝瓶才是关键
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
云河和云昊对击一拳。
没有想象中，云昊被打飞出去的场景。
更没有云昊吐血倒地。
反而是云河，腾腾倒退六七步，整条手臂都在颤抖。
脸色苍白，额头汗珠滚滚。
一脸惊愕，像是见到鬼一般，眼神死死盯着云昊。
而云昊呢？
居然纹丝未动。
两人的情况完全是调转了角色。
“你怎么可能？”
云河呆呆看着云昊，心里无比难受，破防了。
在他心里，他十岁去武馆习武，如今更是登堂入室，踏入三流武夫之门，可以说是真正的武者了。
而云昊就是一个低贱的泥腿子，是个小杂种。
他云河是天之骄子。
现在被一个泥腿子一拳打退数步，这让云河难以接受。
更让云河无法接受的是，刚才和云昊的一拳对击之下，他居然感受到云昊的力量比他还大。
这会儿拳头上皮肉都裂开，整条手臂麻木发颤。
“这不可能，一定是我大意了。”
云河内心给自己找理由自我安慰：“对，一定是这样，我刚才没出全力，大意了。”
围观的村民，也都是一个个难以置信，看着云昊和云河分开。

小声议论。
“咦，云昊没吃亏，反而是云河倒退五六步，这也太奇怪了吧？”
“好家伙，云河是三流武夫，云昊可没有练过武，平日都是食不果腹，居然能和云河硬碰不落下风。”
“什么不落下风，分明是云昊赢了。”
“对啊，没见云河拳头都裂开流血了么？”
“我看是云河大意了，没出全力。”
“我也觉得是云河大意了，这是意外……”
有人为云昊说话，有人站云河。
吴秋兰和云大顺，看到儿子居然没占到便宜，也都是一脸惊讶。
吴秋兰跳起来道：“河儿，云昊这个小杂种就不是云家血脉，是捡来的白眼狼，你不要留手，直接打死他。”
她自然也认为是自家儿子大意了。
云河听到围观村民和母亲说话，脸上青一阵白一阵，好不难受。
虽然不想承认，但他知道，这一拳的确是自己输了。
可也正是如此，他内心更加恼羞成怒。
云昊一个没有习武的废物而已，怎么能比自己强？
之前说过云昊能接下他一拳就放过，这会儿也不认了。
看着云昊，云河低沉无比道：“好好好，你很好，本来还想给你个小教训，现在看来你个小杂种居然有点野蛮力气，既如此，那就休怪我无情了。”
云昊这一刻脸上有了笑意。
他本以为，云河习武十年，是个什么狗屁三流武夫，自己应该打不过，甚至都做好了，被打残的心理准备。
谁知道，刚才一拳之下，他硬碰云河的拳头，居然没有感受到了多大力气，仅仅是拳头上疼了一点点而已。

而云河被自己一拳打得后退数步。
这让云昊内心大定。
content_en:
Yun He and Yun Hao exchanged punches.
The scene where Yun Hao was beaten away was not what he imagined.
Not to mention Yun Hao vomiting blood and falling to the ground.
Instead, Yunhe and Tengteng took six or seven steps back, their whole arms trembling.
His face was pale and beads of sweat rolled on his forehead.
There was a look of shock on his face, as if he had seen a ghost, and his eyes were fixed on Yun Hao.
And what about Yun Hao?
It didn't move at all.
The situation between the two is a complete reversal of roles.
"How could you?"
Yun He looked at Yun Hao blankly, feeling extremely uncomfortable and his defense was broken.
In his mind, he went to a martial arts school to practice martial arts at the age of ten. Now he has entered the hall and entered the ranks of third-rate martial arts. He can be said to be a true martial artist.
And Yunhao is just a lowly mud-legged guy, a little bastard.
He Yunhe is the proud son of heaven.
Now being knocked back several steps by a punch from a mud-legged man was hard for Yun He to accept.
What Yun He couldn't accept even more was that during the punch exchange with Yun Hao just now, he actually felt that Yun Hao's power was greater than his.
At this moment, the skin and flesh on his fists were cracked, and his whole arm was numb and trembling.
"This is impossible. I must have been careless."
Yun He mentally found reasons to comfort himself: "Yes, that must be the case. I didn't use my full strength just now, and I was careless."
The surrounding villagers were all in disbelief as they watched Yun Hao and Yun He separate.
Discussing quietly.
"Hey, Yun Hao didn't suffer, but Yun He took five or six steps back. Isn't this too strange?"
"Good guy, Yun He is a third-rate martial artist, and Yun Hao has never practiced martial arts. He usually doesn't have enough to eat, but he can actually compete head-on with Yun He without losing."
"Why don't you fall behind? Yun Hao obviously wins."
"That's right. Didn't you see that Yun He's fist was cracked and bleeding?"
"I think Yunhe was careless and didn't use his full strength."
"I also think Yunhe was careless. It was an accident..."
Some people spoke for Yun Hao, while others stood by Yun He.
Wu Qiulan and Yun Dashun were both surprised when they saw that their son didn't take advantage.
Wu Qiulan jumped up and said: "He'er, this little bastard Yunhao is not a bloodline of the Yun family. He is a picked-up white-eyed wolf. Don't hold back, just beat him to death."
Naturally, she also thought that her son was careless.
When Yun He heard the onlookers talking to his mother, his face turned blue and white, and he felt very uncomfortable.
Although he didn't want to admit it, he knew that he had indeed lost this punch.
But precisely because of this, he became even more irritated and angry.
Yun Hao is just a loser who has no martial arts training. How can he be better than himself?
I said before that Yun Hao would let him go if he could take one punch, but he didn't admit it now.
Looking at Yun Hao, Yun He said in a very low voice: "Okay, okay, you are very good. I originally wanted to teach you a lesson, but now it seems that you little bastard has some brutal strength. In this case, don't blame me for being ruthless."
Yun Hao had a smile on his face at this moment.
He originally thought that Yun He had been practicing martial arts for ten years and was some kind of bullshit third-rate martial artist that he couldn't beat. He was even mentally prepared to be beaten and disabled.
Who would have thought that with the punch just now, when he hit Yun He's fist head-on, he didn't feel much strength, it was just a little pain on his fist.
Yunhe was knocked back several steps by his punch.
This made Yunhao feel at ease.
